setup.title: Set up the first admin
setup.invalid.heading: This link does not work
setup.invalid.text: The link is invalid, expired or already used.
setup.account.heading: Create the admin account
setup.account.intro: This link works once. First the account, then two-factor authentication. Both are required.
setup.totp.heading: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.totp.intro: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6 digit code it shows.
setup.totp.qr.alt: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.totp.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in your app:
setup.done.heading: Admin account created
setup.done.intro: These recovery codes are your way back in if you lose your authenticator app. Each works once.
setup.done.warning: They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe, for example in a password manager.
setup.done.confirm: I have saved the recovery codes.
